claims.statement: DEP02-A heater jumped from 399.44 at LOT-1227 to 412.72 at LOT-1229 and stayed at 413.35 at LOT-1239
Measured thickness after the jump is 509.82 for LOT-1234 versus 501.9 for LOT-1227 before
Re-measurement of LOT-1234 on MET01 reads 509.55 and is still out of control, confirming real film
Only heater_temp_C shows a large recent shift with z_score 78.4 versus rf_power_W z_score 1.2
Only DEP02-A shows max 509.82 with 1 out of control wafer while DEP01-A mean is 501.39 and DEP01-B mean is 501.71

disposition.summary: Heater on DEP02-A truly ran hot starting at LOT-1229, and wafers after came out thick. Re-measurement on the other metrology tool confirms the thick film is real. Hold the alarm lot and the chamber.

notes.text: Investigating the FDC alarm on DEP02-A — starting with the alarm details.
Heater readings jumped ~13°C with thicker film after — checking if this points to a real heater shift or sensor fault.
Re-measurement confirms real thick film — filing the chamber disposition.

truth.explanation: The heater on DEP02-A really is running hot; films since then are thick.
